newMaterialFindings.game: San Francisco 49ers at Los Angeles Rams
newMaterialFindings.finding: 49ers starting/probable starting DT Alfred Collins tore his patellar tendon in Tuesday practice and is out for the season, compounding Sam Okuayinonu's broken-foot absence and materially thinning San Francisco's defensive front immediately before the opener.

otherFreshDiscoverySummary: No newly published accessible Mina Kimes/ESPN, Ringer, PFF, ETR or Sharp item produced a separate genuinely incremental Week 1 construction during this interval.
ETR's currently indexed Week 1 material remains primarily rankings/subscriber content; no unsupported subscriber-only matchup view was inferred.
dedupe: AP, Reuters, ESPN and local 49ers reporting on Collins are one correlated injury event, not multiple independent confirmations.
primaryLedgerDetail: The new Collins record and prior backlog are preserved in governed audits, but data/nfl-expert-weekly.json remains unsafe to replace through the available truncating one-line read path. No destructive whole-file reconstruction was attempted.
